content.name: Mia Russo
content.title: Account Executive
content.summary: Account executive selling advertising packages across podcasts, newsletters and events for a Sydney media group. Moved up from a graduate sales development role in 16 months and billed $486,000 in my first year as an AE, 112% of budget.

experience.title: Account Executive
bullets: Billed $486,000 in advertising revenue in my first 12 months against a $435,000 budget, mostly from direct clients in hospitality and fintech.
Pitch integrated packages combining podcast reads, newsletter sponsorships and live events, raising my average order value to $18,700.
Work with the creative team to deliver campaign recap reports within five business days, which helped renew 70% of my first-year clients.
Prospect 40 new brands a week through LinkedIn, industry events and agency contacts.

experience.title: Graduate Sales Development Representative
bullets: Qualified inbound and outbound leads for a rostering software company selling to aged care and hospitality operators.
Booked 190 meetings in 15 months, with 34% progressing to a paid trial.
Mapped the NSW aged care provider market into a target list of 600 organisations for the sales team.

education.details: Credit average. ATAR 88.2. Sales and negotiation elective with a live client brief.

achievements.title: Rookie of the Year
achievements.detail: Named top first-year seller at the media group's 2025 sales awards.

achievements.title: Gap year travel
achievements.detail: Worked hospitality jobs in Italy in early 2023 and kept up conversational Italian.
